name: attic/arm32
residual: The back end, the assembler and the instruction set left here on 2026-09-10, when LinuxARM became a target this tree builds and ships (configs/env.yml, `task LinuxARM`): they are in std/compiler now.
This is what stayed: Decoder loads it by name rather than importing it, and Decoder itself draws, so nothing headless reaches this.
Not to be confused with FoxA64*, which is ours and is in std/compiler.
